intro: Camping 101: Herbalism is a training quest that directs skilled gatherers to seek specialized wilderness instruction in Elwynn Forest. Upon demonstrating proficiency in harvesting flora, herbalists are pointed toward Herbalist Pomeroy to learn the art of crafting campsite utilities. Completing this training unlocks the ability to create Incense Candles, botanical aids designed to bolster the focus and spirits of spellcasters resting in the field.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... And profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
